landing.title: Turn a photo into a LEGO® mosaic you can build
landing.pitch: Every stud becomes a round 1×1 tile in a real colour you can buy — with the parts list, shopping lists and printable instructions.
landing.dropHint: or drop a photo anywhere · paste with {{shortcut}}
landing.heroAlt: A portrait photo: the left part is the original, the right part the mosaic of round tiles made from it
landing.promiseDevice: Your photo stays on your device
landing.promiseDeviceBody: Everything is computed in your browser. Your photo is never uploaded — not even when you share the mosaic.
landing.promiseColours: Real LEGO® colours you can buy
landing.promiseColoursBody: 40 colours of the round 1×1 tile (part 98138), with prices from BrickLink and LEGO Pick a Brick.
landing.promisePartsBody: Exports for BrickLink, Pick a Brick and Rebrickable, and a printable page for every 16 × 16 panel.
landing.touchHint: Pick one from your photos or files. It never leaves your device.

summary.costHint: Estimated BrickLink price of the tiles, spares included. Base plates and shipping are extra.

viewer.cropHint: Drag to move the photo · pinch or scroll to zoom
viewer.flatHint: This browser can't use WebGL here, so studs are drawn as flat discs. The mosaic and the parts list are not affected.
viewer.label: Mosaic preview, {{w}} × {{h}} studs. Drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom, double-click to fit.

size.presetsHelp: A panel is 16 × 16 studs (12.8 cm). Prices are BrickLink estimates for the tiles.
size.cropHelpOn: Drag the mosaic to move the photo; pinch, scroll or use the slider to zoom.
size.cropHelpOff: Turn on to choose which part of the photo becomes the mosaic.
size.lowResBody: Low resolution for this size: each stud gets fewer than 2 photo pixels, so the mosaic can look blurry. Choose a smaller size, zoom out, or use a larger photo.

natural.name: Natural
natural.desc: Best for people and most photos: true skin tones and gentle colour mixing.

faithful.name: Faithful
faithful.desc: The closest colour for every stud, with fine dithering. Great for colourful scenes.

sepia.name: Sepia
sepia.desc: Warm browns and creams, like an old photograph.

look.textureHelpNatural: How much neighbouring studs mix two close colours to show in-between shades.
look.textureHelp: Dithering: scatters colours to show smooth gradients.
look.skinHelp: Keeps faces in natural skin colours instead of oranges and pinks.
look.skinNaturalOnly: Only used by the Natural style.
look.despeckleHelp: Swaps lone studs that differ from all their neighbours, when that barely changes the picture.
look.baseHelp: The base shows in the small gaps between the round tiles.

colours.maxColoursHelp: Use at most this many colours. Fewer colours means fewer lots to buy.
colours.minLotHelp: Colours with only a few studs are swapped for the next-best colour, so you don't buy a whole lot for three tiles.
colours.fixedStyle: {{style}} uses its own small set of tones. Colours you turn off here are left out of it too.

parts.notOnPab_other: Not on Pick a Brick: {{list}}. Buy these on BrickLink.

build.title: Build it
build.intro_one: Your mosaic is one panel of 16 × 16 studs.
build.intro_other: Your mosaic is {{count}} panels of 16 × 16 studs: {{w}} across and {{h}} down.
build.printHelp: {{pages}} A4 pages: a cover with the colour legend, then one page per panel. Choose “Save as PDF” in the print dialog to keep a copy.
build.stepPanelsTitle: Panels are labelled like a map
build.stepPanels: The letter is the row and the number is the column: A1 is top left, {{last}} is bottom right.
build.stepBase16_one: Build the panel on a 16 × 16 plate ({{count}} plate).
build.stepBase16_other: Build each panel on its own 16 × 16 plate ({{count}} plates in total), so you can work on one at a time.
build.stepBase48_one: Build on a 48 × 48 baseplate; it holds 3 × 3 panels ({{count}} baseplate).
build.stepBase48_other: Build on 48 × 48 baseplates; each holds 3 × 3 panels ({{count}} baseplates).
build.stepRead: Each circle shows the tile colour and its 2-letter code. Columns are numbered 1–16 and rows lettered A–P; faint lines every 4 studs help you count.
build.stepJoin: Place the finished panels side by side in map order, and the picture appears.

shared.bannerSub: The link holds only the colour grid, never a photo.

print.legendNote: The 2-letter codes are printed on every stud on the panel pages. “To order” includes spares.

about.title: About PhotoBrick
about.what: PhotoBrick turns a photo into a mosaic of round 1×1 LEGO® tiles (part 98138) in colours that are actually made and sold, and gives you everything to build it: the parts list, shopping lists for BrickLink, LEGO Pick a Brick and Rebrickable, and printable panel-by-panel instructions.
about.how: The mosaic is made in your browser by a colour-matching engine that works in a perceptual colour space and keeps skin tones natural. Every change regenerates the whole mosaic in a few milliseconds.
about.privacy: Your photo is never uploaded. It is decoded and processed only on your device, and it is gone when you close the page. Share links contain only the grid of colour codes.
about.fanProject: PhotoBrick is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with the LEGO Group, BrickLink or Rebrickable.
about.prices: Prices are snapshots from BrickLink and LEGO Pick a Brick (Denmark) and are estimates only.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.device: Your photo never leaves your device. It is decoded and turned into a mosaic entirely in your browser; nothing about it is sent to a server.
privacy.share: A share link contains only the finished grid of colour codes, in the part of the address after “#”, which browsers don't send to servers. It never contains your photo.
privacy.noTracking: No cookies, no analytics, no ads and no tracking.
privacy.storage: Your look preferences (style, colours and adjustments) are remembered in this browser's local storage, so your next photo starts the same way. Size and crop are not stored.
privacy.server: The server only delivers the app's files. Its logs record the requested path and status, never query strings or share links.
